title: Senior Software Engineer, Containers
locationText: Canada - Remote; Germany - Remote; United Kingdom - Remote; United States - Remote
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell

Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As a Senior Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will design and ship the features, services, and build systems behind Chainguard Containers, working in a small sub-team of two to four engineers that owns one project end to end.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will build that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

This is a product role. You will work directly with Product Managers and customers, make the trade-off calls on the features you own, and ship them.

What the team owns

• Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).

• The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.

• Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.

• Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

What you'll do

• Design, build, and ship new features and services for Chainguard Containers, from a one-page design through production and the first week of customer use.

• Own the trade-offs on your work: scope, sequencing, what to cut, and when "good enough to ship" beats "complete". Say so clearly when a plan is at risk.

• Work with AI coding agents as part of how you build, review, and operate, and help the team raise the bar on how it uses them safely.

• Follow a problem wherever it goes: into another team's service, a customer call, a support ticket, or go-to-market data, rather than stopping at the edge of your own repository.

• Keep the systems you touch healthy: observability, on-call, and the fixes that stop the same page from coming back.

• Write clearly and often. Design notes, pull request descriptions, and status updates are how a remote team moves fast together.

What we're looking for

• 3+ years building and operating software that paying customers use, preferably at a startup or a company in hyper-growth.

• High agency and urgency. You find a way, you do not wait to be unblocked, and you ask for help early when you are stuck.

• Judgment on trade-offs. You can explain why you chose speed here and rigor there, and you can change your mind when the data says to.

• A systems thinker. You reason about how a change moves through the build pipeline, the registry, and the customer's cluster, and you anticipate what breaks next.

• AI-native in how you work. You use agentic coding tools daily and can show what changed in your output because of them.

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Detroit, MI, USA
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

title: Senior Marketing Specialist - Poland
description:
Who we are
We're Hedepy , an online platform on a mission to make mental health care easier to reach through technology. In 2025, over 300,000 therapy sessions happened through our platform, and our vision is to make psychological support available to as many people as possible.
Why this role matters
Poland is one of the biggest markets in the Hedepy portfolio, and one of the most competitive. Your goal will be to grow our market share and significantly raise awareness of Hedepy in the Polish mental health space, so that support reaches the people who need it.
You'll report directly to Caro, our Local CMO for PL/GR/LT/SI, and run the Polish market together with her. You'll also be part of an international marketing team of 15 people.
What you'll do
Influencers and social media (50%)
You'll oversee influencer and social media activities and production, and manage offline events such as PR stunts and brand activations.
Localising acquisition marketing (30%)
You'll take what we run across markets and make it land in Poland: ad assets, landing page copy, mailings, SEO and ad headlines. This is localisation, not translation, so it should read as if it was written for a Polish audience from the start.
Data and strategy (20%)
You'll read the dashboards, understand why a campaign works or stalls, run tests across channels, and turn all of that into a clear point of view. We care most about the long game: user acquisition, share of search, CPA, and whether the brand is actually growing.
Across all three, you'll shape a strategy that fits the Polish market, informed by what works in the category and for our competitors.
What you'll own
After a trial period, the decisions are yours. You'll own content localisation, influencer collaborations, local partnerships and awareness activities, without needing to check with the CMO first.
Requirements
What you bring

•
Experience: at least 3 years in a similar role.

•
Social media: hands-on experience running and optimising channels such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube. Please share examples.

•
Influencer collaborations: you've coordinated them end to end, from research and creator selection through negotiating terms and contracts to execution and a wrap-up with learnings.

•
Language: you'll be translating content into Polish and adapting it for a Polish audience, so writing has to be one of your strengths.

•
Mental health and empathy: a genuine interest in mental health, whether through education or personal experience, and an empathetic personality.

•
Mindset: strategic, curious and insightful, not afraid to dig deep into data, and open to testing new solutions.

Nice to have

• Experience with influencer collaborations for SaaS products or apps.

• Experience with UX optimisation on websites. Please share examples.

Benefits
What we offer

• Remote-first culture, so you can work from anywhere

• 2 free therapy sessions per month through the Hedepy platform :)

• An international team with colleagues from 10 different countries

• Company-wide offsites and workations by the sea 🫶

AI? Yes, but wisely

• We support using AI. Use it to help you, but keep a human filter. We say no to applications written entirely by AI (yes, we can tell). We want to get to know you, not Claude or Gemini.
Sound like you?
Send us your CV along with a few examples of your work: social media channels you've run, influencer collaborations you've led, and, if you have them, website UX optimisations. A few lines on why mental health matters to you are very welcome too.
We're looking forward to meeting you!
- The Hedepy B2C Marketing team 🤗

title: Staff Robotics Engineer, Localization
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Define and evolve the technical architecture and roadmap for Wayve’s onboard localisation capability, aligned with vehicle programmes and product requirements.

- Lead the development of robust state-estimation systems that fuse GNSS, IMU and wheel-odometry signals, with scope to incorporate camera-, RADAR- and LiDAR-based measurements.

- Take localisation solutions from algorithm design and prototyping through production implementation and deployment on real-time vehicle platforms, including robust fault handling and degraded-mode behaviour.

- Develop rigorous validation and benchmarking capabilities, including representative datasets, ground-truth comparisons, performance metrics and regression testing across diverse vehicles, environments and operating conditions.

- Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentorship, working across robotics, calibration, controls, sensors and vehicle-platform teams to drive integration and resolve complex system-level issues.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

Leading the technical development of our onboard localisation capability. You will design and productionise state-estimation systems that combine GNSS, IMU and wheel odometry to provide accurate, reliable vehicle motion and pose estimates across diverse vehicles, environments and operating conditions.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with responsibility for shaping the localisation architecture and technical roadmap, while remaining deeply involved in algorithm development, implementation, validation and onboard deployment. You will work across robotics, calibration, controls, sensor, vehicle-platform and embedded-software teams to ensure localisation is robust, observable and suitable for real-time production use. You will also provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers working across localisation and the broader state-estimation stack.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

Essential

- Deep practical expertise in localisation, state estimation or sensor fusion, with experience combining GNSS, IMU and wheel-odometry measurements.

- Strong understanding of filtering-based estimation methods, including Kalman-family filters such as the EKF or UKF, and nonlinear optimisation approaches such as factor graphs.

- Experience developing and operating localisation or state-estimation systems in production robotics, autonomous vehicles or comparable real-time systems.

- Strong modern C++ software-engineering skills and proficiency in Python for prototyping, analysis, validation and test tooling.

- Experience designing rigorous localisation validation and benchmarking, including accuracy metrics, uncertainty evaluation, ground-truth comparison, regression testing and failure analysis.

- Evidence of hands-on technical leadership, including defining architecture, influencing technical roadmaps, mentoring engineers and collaborating effectively across multiple teams.

Desirable

- Experience incorporating camera-, LiDAR- or RADAR-based measurements into localisation and sensor-fusion systems, including visual, LiDAR or RADAR odometry.

- Hands-on experience with nonlinear optimisation and robotics l

title: Agile Delivery Manager
description:
About Us

In 2019, the founders were working as engineers solving complex cross-domain problems within government organisations.

TwinStream was formed to bring together their collective expertise and experience into a single business, focused on delivering technical excellence and high-quality service to clients.

Since then, the company has grown to over 100 team members across the UK, with colleagues working both on-site with clients, hybrid and remotely from home.

Details:
Salary: £75,000 - £90,000 DOE
Location: Fully remote
Eligibility Requirements: Due to the nature of the work, the successful candidate must be UK-based and eligible for DV clearance.
About the role
TwinStream is seeking a Delivery Manager who can operate confidently across both project and programme-level delivery. This role blends agile, flow-based delivery practices with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, align stakeholders, manage complex risks, and maintain visibility across broader initiatives.
You’ll work closely with Technical Leads, engineers, and senior stakeholders to ensure that software delivery is predictable, well-governed (lightly), and aligned to programme objectives. This role is ideal for someone who can zoom out to see the bigger picture while still helping teams maintain a healthy delivery flow.
Responsibilities
Programme-Level Coordination & Planning

• Coordinate delivery across multiple related projects or workstreams to ensure alignment with programme goals.

• Maintain a clear, high-level view of progress, risks, dependencies, and resource needs across the programme.

• Support roadmap shaping and programme-level planning with Technical Leads and product/strategy stakeholders.

• Facilitate alignment discussions across teams to clarify priorities, architectural considerations, and sequencing decisions.
Agile Delivery Management

• Lead delivery activities using Kanban and flow-based agile practices across one or more teams.

• Maintain visibility of work-in-progress, blockers, throughput, and upcoming priorities.

• Support teams in balancing feature delivery, technical debt, architectural improvements, and research/activity spikes.

• Encourage continuous flow, reducing bottlenecks and ensuring smooth transitions between stages of delivery.
Lightweight Governance & Reporting

• Provide structured but concise reporting suitable for programme sponsors and senior leadership.

• Track progress against objectives, milestones, and commitments across multiple workstreams.

• Capture key decisions, risks, issues, and actions in a lightweight but traceable way.

• Help define and mature TwinStream ’s delivery governance model - ensuring it remains agile and value-driven.
Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

• Identify and manage programme-level risks, ensuring they are surfaced early and escalated appropriately.

• Coordinate cross-team and cross-vendor dependencies with clarity and urgency.

• Use a pragmatic, simple RAID process to maintain visibility and drive mitigation actions.

• Support teams in resolving blockers that span across technical or organisational boundaries.
Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

• Act as the central coordination point for engineering, Technical Leads, internal stakeholders, and (when relevant) customers.

• Communicate delivery updates with clarity, tailored to the audience - technical or non-technical.

• Align expectations around timelines, scope, assumptions, and emerging risks.

• Support commercial teams during pre-sales, estimation, and contract/change discussions as needed.
Continuous Improvement & Ways of Working

• Contribute to improving TwinStream ’s delivery framework, tools, and documentation.

• Help establish scalable delivery patterns as TwinStream takes on more complex and multi-stream programmes.

• Promote transparency, psychological safety, and a culture of proactive delivery.
Key Skills

• Experience managing software delivery across multiple teams or workstreams

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from supply chain, in sectors such as CPG, retail, manufacturing or pharma, who build demand, inventory and capacity plans in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the work of a Supply Chain Analyst.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in supply chain, demand planning, procurement or operations, in sectors such as CPG, retail, manufacturing, pharma or logistics

- Deep hands-on Excel: inventory and demand planning, Solver, data reshaping, multi-criteria lookups and debugging

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

title: Scientific Product Manager
description:
ABOUT CUSPAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

THE ROLE

Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.

YOUR IMPACT

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS & ROADMAP

- Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

- Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

- Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems.

PARTNER LAB ONBOARDING

- Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

- Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

- Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

CLOSED-LOOP CAMPAIGNS

- Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples.

- Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners.

MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

- PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.

- Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia.

- Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab.

title: Software Engineer - Turso
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Turso core database team and help bring forward the future of agentic databases. Turso is both an Open Source database that replaces SQLite-with an ongoing project to also support the Postgres interface-and a Cloud offering where users can create databases on demand. You’ll work closely with customers and other teams at Supabase to build the future of what databases look like in a world where users and agents are creating millions of databases a day.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building database technology tools that scale to billions.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Driving the progress of the Turso Open Source database, in particular the Postgres compatibility layer.

- Making sure code works, and never breaks, and putting the systems and guarantees in place for that to happen.

- Maintaining the Turso Cloud operations, including the Cloud API and data plane operations.

- Improving the scalability of the Turso Cloud operations to support a 100x larger number of databases

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have written databases before, and/or other high-stakes low-level systems like Hypervisors, OS Kernels, storage devices, etc.

- Have experience working with remote teams and Open Source communities.

- Have a passion and experience for correct systems that work, and have the experience in the tools to make that happen: Deterministic Simulation Testing, formal verification methods, fuzz and differential testing, etc.

- Have experience deploying, operating and debugging large scale software systems in production in cloud environments such as AWS & Kubernetes

- Have experience improving the observability, reliability and performance of complex cloud systems.

- Are comfortable working in Rust.

- Are comfortable with LLM-assisted development and evals.

- Are comfortable working with Embedded databases.

- Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.
The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.
As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - AI Infra - SF
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers lead complex deployments of frontier models in production. You will embed with customers where model performance matters, delivery is urgent, and ambiguity is the default. You will use this to map their problems, structure delivery, and ship fast. 

As a Forward Deployed Engineer for AI Infra, you will work directly with customer engineers, researchers and product engineers on optimization problems across semiconductors and AI infrastructure. You will write and debug software, run experiments against real workloads and hardware, and improve the tools and product used across engagements.

You will help define the problem and success criteria, build the software needed to test an approach, and stay with the work through validation and deployment. Work may include inference performance and chip-design optimization. Success means producing results that stand up to correctness and performance checks, and contributing improvements that other engagements can use.

Success in this role means owning the delivery state across workstreams. You will hold the bar on quality and pace and help OpenAI learn through execution.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role, you will:

- Own technical delivery for agreed semiconductor and AI-infrastructure workstreams, from initial scoping and prototypes through validation, production deployment and adoption.

- Work closely with customer engineers to understand their workflows and constraints, define workloads, baselines and success criteria, and help what you build become part of how they work.

- Scope and sequence delivery, identify dependencies and blockers early, and make practical trade-offs between scope, speed and quality as the work develops.

- Personally build and debug production-quality software, including harnesses, integrations and product features that apply frontier models to problems in chip design, verification, inference and performance engineering.

- Design reproducible experiments, evaluations, graders and benchmarks to test approaches, validate correctness and performance, and establish whether improvements hold up in real engineering environments.

- Investigate model behavior and failure modes alongside researchers, contributing evaluation or training data and targeted experiments where they can improve the underlying capability.

- Contribute directly to core product development, working with product engineers to resolve tooling gaps, ship useful improvements and bring field learning into product decisions.

- Lead technical discussions and maintain alignment across customer, Product and Research teams. Build the domain and product fluency to explain capabilities, limitations and results, and keep ownership, risks and next steps clear.

- Turn successful approaches into reusable software, tools and playbooks, reducing the effort needed for future engagements and helping customer teams operate what has been built.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Bring 5+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

- Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments

- Write and review production-grade software, and debug unfamiliar systems across code, integrations and runtime behavior.

- Have built or deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behaviour affects product experience

- Simplify complexity and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

- Communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders

- Spot risks early and adjust without slowing

title: CRM Manager B2C
description:
CRM Manager B2C

About us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.

By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.

What you’ll be doing

As our CRM Manager, you’ll be the person who builds and improves the automated journeys that keep our customers engaged and coming back.

You’ll join our B2C CRM team and take care of the customer lifecycle: automated customer journeys, retention campaigns and conversion rate optimization, rather than one-off campaigns. You’ll work mainly with Product Marketing, plus Product and Legal, to improve engagement, conversion and retention across our 6 million customers. You’ll start hands-on and, within your first months, grow into shaping the strategy. Over time, your focus may move to a specific product. You’ll report to the Lead of our B2C CRM team.

Here’s what your day-to-day will look like:

- Strategy & impact on OKRs - Track how the products you follow are performing against their Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), and design lifecycle and campaign strategies that move them. Join cross-team discussions to understand and influence decisions.

- Campaign and lifecycle setup - Build and run automated journeys (canvases) in our CRM tool, following the shared strategy across channels (email, in-app messages, push and more). That includes segmentation, personalization and creative development.

- Project management - Lead medium-complexity projects with other teams, mainly Product Marketing, plus Product, Legal and Data. Gather requirements, make sure our communications are compliant, and shape the solutions that bring them to life.

- Performance & KPIs - Define project KPIs and run A/B tests. After every launch, check the results on your own (open rates, click-through rates, conversion rates, retention, ROI), then optimize and share insights that shape the next strategy.

- Continuous optimization - Review how we work today and propose improvements. Keep an eye on what competitors are doing and bring ideas and proposals to the team. Keep up with CRM platform releases and suggest ways to improve what we already have.

- AI-driven innovation and automation - Use AI to make campaigns and lifecycle programs more efficient, segmentation more accurate and ideation sharper. Find, propose and ship new ideas that scale the business and challenge the status quo.

Who we’re looking for

We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you’re curious and ready for real ownership, you’ll fit in!
Does this sound like you?

- Experience & education - A Bachelor’s degree in Marketing (or a related field) and around 5 years of hands-on experience designing, managing and optimizing CRM campaigns and lifecycle programs, including automated customer journeys.

- Industry experience - A background in fintech, banking or insurance is preferred. Experience in large-scale retail or in digital B2C apps is also welcome.

- Technical skills - Solid expertise in CRM and marketing automation platforms, and the autonomy to build in them yourself. Knowing Braze is a plus, and experience with similar tools counts.

- Analytical mindset - Strong analytical skills. You look at the results of what you launch and optimize on your own, without being asked, using data to make decisions.

- Stakeholder management - You work well with different teams, gather requirements and turn them into clear, actionable solutions.

- Organization & autonomy - You are highly organized and work well both in a team and on your own.

- Proactivity & adaptability - You learn quickly, take initiative and adapt your approach as things change. You’re happy to be hands-on at the start and ready to take on strategy as you grow.

Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture
Remote - Western US (Pacific or Mountain time zone preferred)
Why Us
NewRocket is a ServiceNow Elite Partner and a Claude Select partner, helping enterprises reimagine how work gets done with ServiceNow and AI. We work with public and private sector organizations, including some of the world’s biggest brands, to simplify processes, remove complexity, and turn the promise of AI into measurable business outcomes. We are “Raising the Bar” in delivering technology’s promise to create new kinds of experiences for our customers.
Our Core Values: Excellence, Creativity, Integrity, Teamwork and Empathy #ExCITE . At NewRocket , these values guide everything we do: they are the foundation of our culture and define how we Go Beyond for our clients.
The Role
About the role
We're hiring a Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture to be the technical leader on our client engagements, working alongside our forward deployed engineers as they build and deploy agentic AI inside complex enterprise environments. This is a billable, client-facing consulting role.
Large enterprises don't run on one system. They run on decades of layered platforms: ERP backbones like SAP and Oracle, service and workflow platforms like ServiceNow, CRM, HR and finance suites, custom integrations, data warehouses, and the identity and security controls that hold it all together. Agentic AI only creates value when it can work safely inside that landscape: reading the right data, taking the right actions, respecting approvals and access controls, and leaving an audit trail that satisfies IT, security and compliance.
On each engagement, you're the person who understands that landscape. You map the client's systems, translate their business goals into the architecture and requirements agents need, and lead the forward deployed engineers through it as they build, so workflows make it out of pilot and into the client's production environment.
What you'll do

•
Lead engagements technically. Serve as the senior technical leader on client engagements, setting architecture direction and guiding the forward deployed engineers who are building alongside you.

•
Map the client's system landscape. Quickly get to grips with each client's environment, including ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, custom systems and the integrations between them, and turn it into a clear picture the engineering team can build against.

•
Translate business processes into agent-ready requirements. Work with client process owners to break down workflows like incident resolution, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash and employee onboarding into the tasks, data, decisions, permissions and human approval points an agent must handle.

•
Design how agents connect to systems of record. Define the integration approach for each engagement: APIs, integration platforms, event streams, MCP and tool-calling layers, and data access patterns.

•
Get workflows into production. Navigate the client's environments, change management, release processes, testing, monitoring and support handoff so agentic workflows move from pilot to production.

•
Clear the path with security and governance. Design identity and access models for agents (service accounts, least privilege, delegated authority), audit logging and controls, and win sign-off from client CISOs, risk teams and auditors.

•
Advise senior client stakeholders. Act as a trusted architecture advisor to client CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects and platform owners, and identify where agentic workflows can expand into new use cases.

•
Strengthen the practice. Turn what you learn on engagements into reusable blueprints, integration playbooks and readiness assessments, and share field insight with our product and engineering teams.

What you bring

• 7 to 10 years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture or technical leadership roles within large, complex enterprise software environments.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Join Axon and Be a Force for Good

At Axon, we're committed to our mission of Protecting Life. We stand at the forefront of tackling society's most pressing safety and justice challenges. Our approach combines innovative devices and cloud software into a comprehensive ecosystem, all driven by collaboration, empathy, and diverse perspectives from those we serve and work with. At Axon, you're not just a team member; you're a key player in a global mission to make a significant difference. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. We are on a moonshot mission to reduce police-related gun violence by 50% over the course of 10 years.

Build VR Solutions for Social Good

Police primarily go through 40 hours of in-service training a year outside of the academy, and most of that time goes to topics like firearm and CPR recertification. There is not enough time to train on everything police need to be aware of. Officers who do learn a skill at in-service practice it once or twice, then are expected to remember it eight months later, under stress. Our goal is training that is more accessible, more memorable, and done more frequently. We call this "Roll Call" training: training that can be done before and after a shift to keep skills sharp.

Public-safety training is broken. Today's training is ineffective, not scalable, and expensive. Axon's VR team creates engaging, effective training with scenario feedback, including Community Engagement Training and less-lethal weapon training (like TASER), so officers are prepared to use alternatives to Use of Force.

Most police interactions are verbal and non-verbal, so we emphasize hand gestures and natural language processing. The trainee's body language, what they say, and how they say it all shape how they interact with NPCs (Non-Playable Characters) in the scenario. A trainer observes these interactions and gives feedback in a post-training debrief, and every product ties back into the Axon ecosystem through Axon Academy, Axon Evidence, Axon Performance, and Axon Standards.

Your Impact

You will join an interdisciplinary team tackling the biggest challenges in public safety training head-on, including immersive VR-based empathy, coping and de-escalation training that helps officers engage with the communities they serve with greater awareness and safety.

As one of the expanding members of Axon's VR team, the Senior Technical Animator is the bridge between art and technology. You will own the animation pipeline and animation systems for our standalone-headset training simulators, turning motion-capture data into believable NPC behavior that runs within tight mobile performance budgets. You will partner with Art, Engineering, Content, UX and User Research to deliver the best immersive quality for our trainings.

This is a senior role. We expect you to work independently, own your area end to end, and take direction from the Lead Technical Artist and the Art Director rather than needing day-to-day management.

We believe happy teams make the best products, so we foster a friendly, open, introspective team culture that encourages everyone to speak their mind, collaborate, and have fun. description:

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку Monetization Manager.

Трохи більше про Payments processing team: це команда, яка стоїть за лаштунками кожного успішного юнікорна. Ми закриваємо “під ключ” зону еквайрингу виручки для бізнесів будь-якої складності та менеджимо відносини зі стейкхолдерами із різних країн, аби вивести свої процеси на якісно новий рівень.

Які виклики чекають:

1. Оптимізація прохідності платежів:

- Моніторинг, аналіз та технічна оптимізація логіки обробки платежів;

- Співпраця з аналітичними та технічними командами для тестування нових платіжних налаштувань та ідей з метою максимізації конверсії в успішну оплату.

2. Робота з ризиками та комплаєнсом:

- Моніторинг та покращення ключових фінансових та операційних метрик ризику;

- Постійне підвищення рівня відповідності вимогам банків, платіжних систем та законодавства.

3. Оптимізація вартості процесингу:

- Аналіз та оптимізація комерційних умов співпраці з партнерами.

Ключові вимоги:

- 4+ роки підтвердженого досвіду в одній або декількох сферах: платежі, білінг, бізнес-аналітика, корпоративні фінанси, аудит, консалтинг або інвестиції;

- Високорозвинені аналітичні навички;

- Високорозвинені навички комунікації;

- Вміння ефективно синтезувати дані в конкретні дії та рішення;

- Навички багатозадачності та гнучкості: здатність працювати у високому темпі з великим колом стейкхолдерів, швидко пристосовуватися до змін та одночасно керувати кількома проєктами та пріоритетами.

Перевагою буде:

- Спеціалізований досвід у сфері платежів: досвід роботи в процесингу платежів на стороні бізнесу або еквайрингу (інтернет-платежі).

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

- Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві.

Запрошуємо будувати the next big everything у SKELAR разом!

(NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most - their team, their guests, and their bottom line - while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the job:

OpenTable is seeking an Account Manager responsible for leading customer retention and revenue growth within your territory of restaurants, reporting to the Manager, Account Managers. In this role, you will be in tune with the local restaurant industry and proactively engage with restaurant customers to serve as a trusted advisor. You will be innovative in overcoming customer obstacles, provide constructive perspectives to challenge current thinking, and use our world-class technology to empower restaurants to focus on their team, their guests, and their bottom line.

Note: Applicants must live in either the Pacific Time Zone or Hawaii- Aleutian Time Zone to align with the team and market. Seattle or Hawaii residence strongly preferred. Domestic travel will be required throughout West Coast and Hawaii.

Responsibilities:

• Cultivate and build upon existing high-level relationships to serve as a trusted advisor to restaurants and lead retention rates by aiding in re-signing customers with expired contracts.

• Account Retention & Revenue Growth: Build and maintain strategic relationships with restaurant leadership to achieve quarterly retention and upsell targets, including contract renewals and premium marketing tool adoption.

• Understand customer needs, identify sales opportunities to sell premium marketing tools, and achieve quarterly company goals and sales objectives.

• Assist restaurant management with system configuration to optimize reservation flow.

• Build and utilize data-driven presentations for ongoing business reviews and educate operators about industry trends using actionable, data-driven insights.

• Act as an advocate and high-level point of contact for restaurant customer concerns and resolve cross-functional issues.

• Track weekly meeting and call activity in Salesforce, conduct monthly meetings with Elite members, and capture product upgrade feedback for the team.

Minimum Qualifications:

• 2-3+ years of account management or equivalent experience in a restaurant/hospitality environment with validated customer service skills.

• Residency in the Pacific Time Zone or Hawaii-Aleutian Time Zone to align with the team and market. Seattle or Hawaii residence strongly preferred. Domestic travel will be required throughout West Coast and Hawaii.

description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

We're looking for a highly motivated Events Lead to own planning and execution of ElevenLabs' flagship events. Your work will deepen ElevenLabs' brand presence, create high-impact moments with customers and prospects, and generate high-quality pipeline in partnership with our GTM teams.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Develop and execute flagship event plans aligned with business objectives across key markets

- Build and maintain relationships with sponsors, partners, agencies, and production vendors across North America

- 8+ years events experience, with at least three in tech/enterprise flagship event marketing

- Track record of producing large-scale, high-profile branded events end to end

- Deep knowledge of the tech ecosystem and executive/enterprise

title: Director of Sales & Customer Success
description:
About Empower Community Care

Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services. Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years - each advancing outcomes for children, families, and the communities we serve. Why Empower Community Care, and Why Now

Empower's mission is to develop, deliver, and sustain evidence-based behavioral health programs, combining clinical excellence with the workforce, data, and technology infrastructure that make lasting system change possible. Our vision is to be the system support partner that states and communities turn to when they need evidence-based care to take hold and hold, not just get piloted and reported on. At the center of that work is a simple belief: families do better when care meets them where they are. Everyone on our team, including the people representing our work in the field, gets to see that belief turn into real families staying together and thriving.
Today, Empower serves more than 3,000,000 families through 2,000-plus customers across all 50 states and 35 countries. We work across the five systems where families need us most: youth justice, child welfare, behavioral health, adult justice and corrections, and early childhood and schools. Joining our sales team means representing evidence-based programs, including MST, FFT, BSFT, and Incredible Years, alongside the assessments, professional development, implementation support, and technology that make those programs work in practice, not just on paper.
Empower is entering a defining, exciting period of growth. We are bringing seven subsidiary brands together into one connected platform, deepening relationships with state governments and Medicaid systems, and building the infrastructure, including a coordinated regional pod model, needed to support that growth. This Sales Director role sits at the center of that transformation: the chance to lead our Specialty Sales Reps through the transition from individual, program-aligned roles into a coordinated regional pod model, help shape how Empower shows up in the market, and define what it means to sell a unified system rather than a single program. Few sales leaders get to join an organization at this exact inflection point, where the platform, the market demand, and the mission are all coming together at once. For a builder who wants real ownership over both strategy and execution, there may not be a better moment to join. Position Summary

Empower Community Care is seeking an experienced, hands-on Director, Sales & Customer Success to build and lead our specialty sales and customer success teams. Today, our Specialty Sales Reps function as independent contributors aligned to individual programs. This is a foundational leadership role: the Director, Sales & Customer Success will bring structure, coaching, and consistency to this team as it exists today, while helping architect and lead the transition toward a regional pod model over time.
Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, this role will manage and coach the Specialty Sales Reps aligned to our community-based clinical programs (MST, FFT, BSFT), early childhood and prevention programming (Incredible Years), and assessment and behavior-change tools (Orbis/Carey Group), along with the Customer Success function. Enterprise Sales Reps report directly to the CGO; the Director, Sales & Customer Success will work in close, daily partnership with Enterprise reps to ensure tight collaboration, consistent hand-offs, and a coordinated customer experience across Empower's capabilities: evidence-based programs (MST, FFT, BSFT, and Incredible Years), Assessment & Behavioral Change Solutions, and Organizational Strategy and Advisory.

The Senior Informaticist serves as a strategic analytics partner supporting Humana Clinical Pharmacy Review (HCPR) and the pharmacy Prior Authorization (PA) process. You will work with business leaders, clinical and operational partners, and analytics teams to translate complex business and operational challenges into analytical questions, investigate the drivers of performance, and develop meaningful recommendations.
The Senior Informaticist will use governed data and modern analytical tools to evaluate Prior Authorization activity and operational performance, identify trends and opportunities, investigate potential drivers of outcomes, and help business partners understand not only what is occurring, but why it is occurring and what actions may improve results.
Your success requires a combination of healthcare and pharmacy knowledge, analytical curiosity, and business partnership. The Senior Informaticist serves as a strategic problem solver supporting Humana Clinical Pharmacy Review and pharmacy Prior Authorization operations . You will partner across business, clinical, operations, technology, and analytics teams to address complex and often ambiguous challenges affecting PA processes, operational performance, regulatory reporting, and outcomes.

• Lead complex analytical programs supporting HCPR and pharmacy Prior Authorization , with accountability from problem identification through recommendation, implementation, and measurement of results.

• Translate complex or ambiguous PA, clinical, operational, and business questions into structured analytical approaches and applicable recommendations.

• Analyze Prior Authorization activity and operational performance to identify trends, potential drivers, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

• Combine information across multiple data sources and operational processes to develop a complete view of performance and identify causes.

• Partner with HCPR leadership and teams to support regulatory and compliance reporting requirements and evolving pharmacy needs.

• Develop analytical frameworks, reporting solutions, and decision-support tools that improve transparency and promote informed decision-making.

• Communicate complex findings, assumptions, risks, and recommendations to all audiences, including senior leadership.

• Take ownership of analytical projects, independently determining appropriate approaches, partner engagement, analytical requirements, and deliverables.

• Identify opportunities to improve PA reporting, operational processes, data quality, and analytical capabilities while challenging assumptions and driving sustainable solutions.

• Support modernization of HCPR analytics through tools and platforms such as Databricks and Power BI , while maintaining appropriate data governance and reporting standards.

We are looking for someone with exceptional critical thinking, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to connect data, Prior Authorization processes, regulatory requirements, and partner needs to practical solutions.
